_alias_why: A removed node that other records still point at leaves a dangling reference. Where the removal is a COLLAPSE rather than a deletion, the id is aliased to its survivor and every remaining reference is re-pointed. Deletions (the 31 locations) have no alias because nothing should point at them. As of 22 August 2026 the alias map also re-points EDGES, not just timeline rows and person back-references. An edge touching a collapsed node is a real relationship recorded against the wrong copy, and dropping it costs evidence; it is now merged onto the survivor, with self-edges discarded. Applying that to the aliases already in this file recovered 27 edges the August collapses had deleted.
